subject: Next steps: HelixHealth pilot readiness & security evidence checklist
messages:
From: Tom Blake <tom.blake@helixhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@helixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + asks from today's kickoff call

Thanks for taking the time today, Logan — good call. Quick recap from our side and a list of items we need to progress the pilot and the security review: 

Call recap (high level):
- Pilot scope: 2-week proof-of-concept focused on clinical note summarization (500–1k notes/day).
- Success criteria: latency < 600ms p50, output quality >= current on-call baseline per 10 sample prompts.
- Data: anonymized production subset (PHI redacted) will be used for evaluation.

Security/compliance asks (priority order):
1) Latest SOC 2 Type II report or letter of attestation.
2) Recent external penetration test summary (redacted findings OK).
3) Example audit logs (schema and a 7-day sample).
4) Data retention policy for logs and model inputs.
5) Details on where data is stored for hosted vs dedicated (region and segmentation).

Procurement/legal/process questions:
- Economic buyer: who should we route commercial terms to (we will likely need a PO + SOW)?
- Procurement timeline: target to complete procurement by mid-September to start pilot the week after.

Next steps from Helix: Aditi (copied) will coordinate with procurement and security. Please send the evidence items and a suggested mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align timelines.

Thanks — Tom

--
Tom Blake
Director of Engineering, Platform
HelixHealth
Tom.Blake@helixhealth.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Tom Blake <tom.blake@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@helixhealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + asks from today's kickoff call

Tom — thanks for the clear recap. We're aligned on scope and the success criteria. Below is what we'll deliver this week and owners on our side. I also attached a one-page MAP to make the procurement timeline explicit.

Deliverables (this week):
- SOC 2 Type II attestation (PDF) — Logan (me)
- Redacted pen test summary (PDF) — Neha
- Audit log schema and 7-day sample (JSONL stub) — Neha
- Data retention and deletion policy (PDF) — Logan
- MAP (timeline + milestones) — attached spreadsheet (mutual_action_plan_helixhealth.xlsx)

Questions for Helix:
- Confirm economic buyer/contact for commercial terms (I noted Aditi will route to procurement; please confirm the person and email).
- Will you require a dedicated VPC deployment for the pilot or is the hosted tenant OK for the initial 2-week run?

Proposed timeline (high level):
- 24–27 Aug: evidence delivery + legal/procurement kickoff
- 30 Aug–10 Sep: pilot engineering work (data ingestion + integrations)
- 13 Sep: start pilot run (2 weeks)

If that looks good, we'll upload the attachments to the compliance mailbox and share secure links.

Regards,

Logan Wright
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_helixhealth.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Blake <tom.blake@helixhealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@helixhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence index + quick technical clarifications

Hi Tom / Aditi — I pulled together the evidence items we discussed and a short tech Q list so the security team can validate quickly. I've attached an index file that lists each artifact and the level of redaction.

Attached (draft):
- security_evidence_index.csv (index)
- pen_test_summary_redwood_redacted.pdf (summary, findings redacted)

Evidence notes (high level):
- SOC 2: full Type II report delivered to compliance mailbox; we'll provide a secure link.
- Pen test: vendor report summary with remediation status; can provide full report under NDA if needed.
- Audit logs: we can supply JSONL structured logs (timestamp, request_id, model_variant, token_count, region, action). Sample attached as audit_logs_sample_7days.jsonl (redacted ids).
- Data residency: hosted deployments store data in the region selected (we have us-west and eu-west); Dedicated keeps data in-customer-VPC.

Technical questions:
1) For the audit log sample, do you need syslog format or JSONL?
2) Does Helix require field-level encryption for payloads in transit beyond TLS?
3) Any constraints on the certificate chain for dedicated deployment?

Looping in Rishi for procurement cadence. I can jump on a 20-min call with your security lead if that helps.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: security_evidence_index.csv, pen_test_summary_redwood_redacted.pdf
From: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@helixhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@helixhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence index + quick technical clarifications

Thanks — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

Procurement / economic buyer:
- Economic buyer: Maya Patel, CFO (maya.patel@helixhealth.com). She signs off on pilot commercial commitments > $10k.
- Procurement process: our procurement team issues a PO after SOW + 30-day payment terms; we usually need the SOW 10 business days before start.

Security requirements & timeline:
- Required: SOC 2 Type II (full report preferred), pen test summary (redacted ok), and sample audit logs (7-day).
- Our security team prefers JSONL audit logs. Ability to provide field-level redaction is a plus.
- Target: security review complete by 10 Sep so we can start pilot on 13 Sep.

Dedicated vs hosted:
- For POC, hosted tenant is acceptable as long as data is redacted and region is us-west. If pilot later expands, procurement will evaluate Dedicated/VPC options.

I'll route the above to Maya and CC procurement; they may request a short SOW and standard terms. If you can provide the evidence and MAP by end of day tomorrow (27 Aug), procurement will start review.

Best,
Aditi
Head of Data Platform
HelixHealth
aditi.shah@helixhealth.com
